how_to_read.tier: stated = the words are in the text; inferred = only implied (offered as a suggestion, never extracted); by_rule = made by a rule, not read; known_gap = expected but waits for a slice not yet built
how_to_read.relation: parent_of, sibling, spouse, uncle_of, apprentice_of, mentor_of, owns, carries, knows (+ one of nine feeling words), member, leads, works_for, enemy_of, rival_of, held_captive_by, associate; place ties by word: lives_in, works_in, comes_from, last_seen_in (a character, creature or group), kept_in (an item: only ever kept in a place); in (only a place or an event inside a place)
how_to_read.direction: a to b: parent_of (a is the parent), owns (a owns b), leads (a leads group b), member (a belongs to b), in (a place or event is inside place b); sibling, spouse and rival_of read the same both ways
how_to_read.must_find: false = a good find if present, not a miss if absent; an inferred tie that must be found is scored as an offered suggestion

map facts: twenty miles from Targos to Kelvin's Cairn; Bryn Shander is a few hours' dogsled from Easthaven
must_not_find: any link made from dice rolls, hit points, temporary hit points, exhaustion, conditions or spells
the 'Xanathar's origin rolls' table: the letters TN and NE are alignments, not people or places
'Claude yells to Claude' is a typing slip in the lore, so no link from Claude to himself
'my child', 'brother' and 'Father' used as forms of address are not family ties
the instructions block (purpose, response style, transcript corrections) is about how to write a summary, not about the story
the book-cover blurb at the top is not the campaign's own story
Vellynne Harpell and Nass Lantomir appear only in a proper-names list: names, but no invented ties
the Dzaan Red Wizard 'Arcane Brotherhood' tie is stated; do not widen it to the whole party
